name: @proworks-hub/assetfinanceiq
description: AssetFinanceIQ — the financial representation of fixed assets: capitalization policy, depreciation as cumulative functions over method epochs, MACRS with a population-scoped mid-quarter determination, impairment with framework-bound reversal, disposal. Never the physical asset (AssetIQ), never the journal (LedgerIQ).
author: Steven Kreutzer
